payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_baseline.py::test_failures_differing_only_in_detail_share_one_identity stayed green with the criterion's own edit applied to saffron/gates/contract.py. The claim was '`identity` never reads `detail`. Two failures alike but for their detail share one identity. `subtract_baseline` cancels a head failure against a baseline failure that differs only in detail, and `is_no_progress` reads two such new-failure lists as no progress. The witness gives the two a detail each with no digits, so `normalize_message` cannot make them equal. The one failure that survives the subtraction keeps its own detail.'. Under the edit the whole `tests` gate failed tests/test_contract.py::test_identity_separates_two_failures_of_the_same_code_in_one_file, tests/test_contract.py::test_normalize_message_collapses_whitespace, tests/test_prose_gate.py::test_a_long_sentence_that_grows_past_its_excerpt_is_new, tests/test_prose_gate.py::test_a_new_long_comment_is_new_though_an_old_one_is_trimmed, and the criterion's witness did not fail.
